scope: Hermes/NAVE only; read-only research; no OpenClaw; no execution

forward_journal.use: audit context only; not a historical event panel

memecoin_cache.use: current/provider cache; not suitable for same-pool temporal replay

historical_replay_archives.reason: No PumpApi .jsonl.zst event archive was present in the workspace

public_corpus_parquet.reason: The 6.7GB public corpus was not downloaded; no corpus query was run

required_primary_source.name: PumpApi Historical Replay
required_primary_source.required_artifact: contiguous UTC .jsonl.zst files covering launches plus every declared outcome horizon

frozen_universe_and_splits.universe: all launches in declared replay interval, including rejected, dead, unexitably, and censored records
frozen_universe_and_splits.deduplication: one record per mint and pool epoch; preserve event order and pool identity
frozen_universe_and_splits.purge: purge examples whose future outcome horizon overlaps the next split; 72h Runner labels require at least 72h embargo

quality_rules.mayhem_supply: use corrected supply or explicit protocol supply; never assume 1B
quality_rules.corrupt_sol_rows: exclude from SOL volume/P&L and retain quality flag
quality_rules.missing_price_rows: retain missingness; do not treat as zero
quality_rules.system_program: exclude documented System Program address from wallet features
quality_rules.wallet_stats: never use activity/volume totals; recompute from trades
quality_rules.graduation_leakage: exclude entry_price_20s_usd, entry_price_30s_usd, entry_price_1m_usd from predictive features
quality_rules.right_censoring: target beyond collection end is UNKNOWN/right-censored, never DEAD or NON-RUNNER
